sn46.56:1.2: Ekam samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate || || 2.
sn46.56:1.3: Atha kho Abhayo rājakumāro yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antam nisinno kho Abhayo rājakumāro Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn46.56:1.5: Natthi hetu natthi paccayo aññaṇāya adassanāya
sn46.56:1.7: Natthi hetu natthi paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya
sn46.56:1.10: Atthi rājakumāra hetu atthi paccayo aññaṇāya adassanāya
sn46.56:1.12: Atthi rājakumāra hetu atthi paccayo ñānāya dassanāya
sn46.56:1.13: sahetu sapaccayo ñānaṃ dassanaṃ hotī ti || || I. 5.
sn46.56:2.1: Katamo pana bhante hetu katamo paccayo aññānāya adassanāya ||
sn46.56:2.2: kathaṃ sahetu sapaccayo aññānam adassanaṃ hotī ti || || 6.
sn46.56:2.3: Yasmiṃ kho rājakumāra samaye kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena || uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇam yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati ||
sn46.56:2.4: ayam pi kho rājakumāra hetu ayam paccayo aññāṇaya adassanāya ||
sn46.56:2.5: evam pi sahetu sapaccayo aññānaṃ adassanaṃ hoti || || 7.
sn46.56:3.1: Puna ca param rājakumāra yasmiṃ samaye byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati byāpādaparetena || la || 8.
sn46.56:3.4: Vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati vicikicchāparetena || uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati ||
sn46.56:3.5: ayam pi kho rājakumāra hetu ayam paccayo aññaṇāya adassanāya || ||
sn46.56:3.6: Evam pi sahetu sapaccayo aññāṇam adassanaṃ hoti || || 11.
sn46.56:4.5: ekamekena pi kho bhante nīvaraṇena abhibhūto yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya || ko pana vādo pañcahi nīvaraṇehi || || 12.
sn46.56:5.1: Katamo pana bhante hetu katamo paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya ||
sn46.56:5.2: kathaṃ sahetu sapaccayo nānam dassanaṃ hotī ti || || 13.
sn46.56:5.3: Idha rājakumāra bhikkhu satisambojjaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇamiṃ ||
sn46.56:5.4: so satisambojjhaṅgam bhāvitena cittena yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati ||
sn46.56:5.5: ayam pi kho rājakumāra hetu ayam paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya ||
sn46.56:5.6: evam pi sahetu sappaccayo ñānaṃ dassanaṃ hoti || 14--18.
sn46.56:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ rājakumāra bhikkhu || la [pe] || 19.
sn46.56:6.2: Upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ ||
sn46.56:6.3: so upekhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāvitena cittena yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati ||
sn46.56:6.4: ayam pi kho rājakumāra hetu ayam paccayo ñānāya dassanāya ||
sn46.56:6.5: evaṃ sahetu sappaccayo ñāṇam dassanaṃ hotī ti || || 20.
sn46.56:7.5: ekamekena pi kho bhante bojjhaṅgena samannāgato yathābhūtam jāneyya passeyya || ko pana vādo sattahi bojjhaṅgehi || ||
sn46.56:7.6: Yo pi me bhante Gijjhakūṭam pabbatam ārohantassa kāyakilamatho cittakilamatho so pi me paṭipassaddho || dhammo ca me abhisameto ti || ||
sn46.56:8.4: Gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate ti Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttassa Bojjhaṅgasākaccaṃ chaṭṭham || || 1. Sāvatthi || || 2.
